meta.tool: Claude SEO 2.5.0 (claude-seo plugin) in a Claude Code cloud session
meta.data_sources: Sitemap crawl (500 URLs, primary locale), 18 saved representative pages, headless Chromium lab runs, WebSearch SERP sample. No Search Console, CrUX, GA4, Moz or PageSpeed Insights data (PSI keyless quota exhausted).
limitations: 32 of 500 crawled URLs (mostly blog articles) returned 429 and later all paths returned 403 'cf-mitigated: challenge' to the audit client; the challenge was not bypassed. Effect on verified Googlebot/Bingbot was not measured.
Performance numbers are lab measurements from a datacenter with CPU/network throttling, not field data. INP not measured.
SERP observations are one WebSearch sample on 2026-11-02, not verified Google rankings.
International sub-folders (/en-intl, /ja-intl, /zh-intl) and the Canada site were not audited in depth.

summary.business_type: E-commerce (Shopify) - European infant formula retailer, YMYL
summary.score_method: Weighted: Technical 22%, Content 23%, On-Page 20%, Schema 10%, Performance 10%, AI Search Readiness 10% (GEO 60% + agent readiness 40%), Images 5%

top_findings.title: Flagship buying guide gives health advice that contradicts EU law and the site's own product pages
top_findings.description: /blogs/parenting-tips/best-organic-baby-formula-which-is-safest-for-your-child tells parents DHA/ARA should be avoided 'whenever possible', while the HiPP Stage 1 PDP states DHA and ARA are required under EU formula regulation. The article also recommends Jovie, which the store does not sell (0 of 317 sitemap products), and /what-to-feed-your-infant advises avoiding allergenic foods.

top_findings.title: Homepage hero is a 48.5 MB video that keeps the H1 and CTA invisible
top_findings.description: https://cdn.shopify.com/videos/c/o/v/0e80a1164c1044978c48e20afc7ca391.mp4 is 48,543,322 bytes, 1080p60, no poster. H1, value proposition and the only hero CTA stay at opacity 0 until the video ends (about 24.5 s in throttled lab runs).

top_findings.title: Conflicting feeding and preparation charts on infant-formula product pages
top_findings.description: /products/hipp-formula-stage-1 shows HiPP's own chart (0-2 weeks: 2 scoops / 60 ml) and a generic chart with different amounts; the generic block also appears on Holle and Lebenswert pages.

top_findings.title: No named author or medical reviewer on YMYL content; trust pages contradict each other
top_findings.description: Articles are 'Posted by Formuland' and Article schema uses a Person named 'Formuland'. About pages disagree (500,000 vs 1M orders, California vs main office in Europe); no address found; /pages/our-company has 0 inbound links.

top_findings.title: Shipping, duties and return statements contradict each other
top_findings.description: PDPs, collections and a legacy popup give different free-shipping thresholds, delivery windows (2-4, 2-7, 1-6 days) and origins; the PDP says duties are covered while its disclaimer makes the buyer responsible; the refund policy says formula is non-returnable while the PDP promises a 30-day store-credit guarantee.

top_findings.title: European baby formula comparison chart is image-only
top_findings.description: /pages/european-baby-formula-comparison-chart has 5 words of HTML text, 0 tables and 0 product links; competing chart pages use HTML tables and 1,700-4,300 words.

quick_wins: Product template: change the 'Product & Purchase Disclaimer' H1 to H2 (44 PDPs) and delete the generic feeding chart block.

Homepage hero: make the H1/CTA overlay visible at first paint, add a poster image and a <= 2 MB faststart mobile video; point the hero CTA at /collections/organic-baby-formula instead of the redirecting -temp URL.
Add an H1 and a meta description to /pages/about-us, /pages/nara-organics-formula-recall and /pages/contact; 301 /pages/our-company to /pages/about-us.
Make the canonical tag unconditional in the product template (50 PDPs have none).
Add BreadcrumbList and gtin13 to Product JSON-LD; point Article mainEntityOfPage at the article URL.
Hide utility pages and the 6 stale Avada HTML sitemap pages with seo.hidden and remove the Avada app.
Lazy-load the 28 header flag images and serve one hero image per viewport (about 210 KB saved on mobile).

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS with HSTS, CSP frame-ancestors, X-Frame-Options and nosniff
Server-rendered HTML; key pages do not depend on JS for text
Clean Shopify robots.txt with facet/sort rules and a sitemap index
No noindex leaks found in 468 crawled 200 pages; TTFB about 250 ms unthrottled

findings.title: Cloudflare bot challenge on non-browser clients
findings.description: 32 URLs returned 429 'Verifying your connection...' in the crawl; later every path including /robots.txt returned 403 cf-mitigated: challenge for about 7 minutes.
findings.recommendation: Review Cloudflare/Shopify bot settings and security events; confirm verified bots (Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) are exempt; check Crawl Stats in Search Console.

findings.title: 50 of 249 crawled products have no rel=canonical
findings.description: Affected: HiPP Baby Soft, Earth Mama, Weleda, diapers, LittleOak formula products.
findings.recommendation: Output {{ canonical_url }} unconditionally in theme.liquid / the product template; verify with view-source on 3 affected URLs.

findings.title: Utility, duplicate and thin pages are indexable and in the sitemap
findings.description: customer-portal, quiz-results (duplicates formuland-quiz), shipping-protection product, 6 Avada HTML sitemap pages (120 of 193 links point to formuland.myshopify.com).
findings.recommendation: Set the seo.hidden metafield on utility pages, delete the Avada pages and uninstall the app.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod is unreliable
findings.description: All 316 products share one lastmod timestamp; ja-intl/zh-intl lastmod equals request time.
findings.recommendation: Find the app bulk-touching products; keep lastmod meaningful so Google trusts it.

findings.title: Duplicate x-default hreflang where two hreflang systems overlap
findings.description: Theme block (en-US, en-CA, x-default) plus Shopify Markets block (29 tags); 142 US-only products correctly have no Markets block.
findings.recommendation: Drop the theme x-default on pages where the Markets block is present.

findings.title: AI-agent robots.txt group does not inherit * rules
findings.description: /admin, /apps/loyalty and sort_by URLs are allowed for the AI group.
findings.recommendation: Copy the Disallow lines into that group.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Long, detailed product pages (median about 1,977 words) and collections (median about 1,822)
Recall page is well-sourced
Large blog library (142 articles) on core parent questions

findings.title: Health misinformation in the flagship organic-formula guide
findings.description: DHA/ARA 'avoid these whenever possible' contradicts EU 2016/127 and the site's own PDPs; recommends a brand not sold; outdated allergen-avoidance advice in /what-to-feed-your-infant.
findings.recommendation: Correct or unpublish the passages now; rewrite with citations and a named, credentialed reviewer (pediatric dietitian/pediatrician).

findings.title: No identifiable author, credentials or medical review
findings.description: 'Posted by Formuland' on every article; no reviewer, no sources section, mismatched dates.
findings.recommendation: Create author and reviewer profile pages; add 'Medically reviewed by' with date and credentials; cite primary sources.

findings.title: Conflicting feeding charts on PDPs
findings.description: Generic chart conflicts with the manufacturer chart on HiPP, Holle and Lebenswert pages.
findings.recommendation: Show only the manufacturer's chart for each product.

findings.title: Trust pages contradict each other
findings.description: 500,000 vs 1M orders/families; California vs Europe office; 10 years vs founded 2014; no address or phone found.
findings.recommendation: Merge into one About page with verified facts, address, founders and team; 301 the duplicate.

findings.title: Templated or unsupported product copy
findings.description: Holle/Lebenswert copy is generic; Lebenswert copy claims benefits for 'learning difficulties and dyslexia' without support.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite with manufacturer-verified facts; remove unsupported health claims.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Every crawled page has a title and canonical-safe URL structure
Collections have unique, descriptive H1s

findings.title: Meta descriptions are auto-excerpts
findings.description: 338 of 468 exceed 160 characters; 146 are cut mid-sentence; 13 missing.
findings.recommendation: Write 140-155 character descriptions, starting with top collections, products and the 30 most-visited articles.

findings.title: Trust and YMYL pages lack H1 and meta description
findings.description: /pages/about-us, /pages/nara-organics-formula-recall, /pages/contact, FAQ.
findings.recommendation: Add one descriptive H1 and a meta description to each.

findings.title: Second H1 in the product template
findings.description: 44 PDPs have 'Formuland - Product & Purchase Disclaimer' as an extra H1.
findings.recommendation: Change it to H2 or a styled paragraph.

findings.title: Long, keyword-stuffed titles
findings.description: 196 titles exceed 60 characters; homepage title repeats 'European ... Formula' four times.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite templates to 50-60 characters: primary keyword, differentiator, brand.

findings.title: Weak internal linking to commercial collections
findings.description: 88 crawled URLs have 1 or fewer inbound links; /collections/hipp-formula-stage-1..4 and /collections/kendamil-organic-formula are not linked from crawled pages.
findings.recommendation: Link stage and brand collections from navigation, PDP breadcrumbs and related articles.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All 31 JSON-LD blocks parse; no microdata/RDFa conflicts or deprecated types
Product with Offer and AggregateRating matching visible reviews (HiPP 4.91 / 107)
Organization and WebSite on every page

findings.title: Return policy contradiction blocks hasMerchantReturnPolicy
findings.description: /policies/refund-policy says formula is non-returnable; PDP promises a 30-day store-credit guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the policy text first, then add MerchantReturnPolicy (see findings/schema.md options A/B).

findings.title: No shippingDetails or GTIN on offers
findings.description: Valid EAN-13 barcodes exist in Shopify data; multipack variants reuse the single-can barcode.
findings.recommendation: Add OfferShippingDetails and gtin13 from the single-unit variant; give multipacks their own identifiers or omit.

findings.title: Two Product nodes per PDP with the same relative @id
findings.description: Theme block carries offers; Judge.me block carries reviews.
findings.recommendation: Emit one merged Product node or use an absolute shared @id.

findings.title: BreadcrumbList missing on products and articles
findings.description: Present on 2 of 74 collections, 0 of 249 products, 0 articles.
findings.recommendation: Use the paste-ready graph in findings/schema.md.

findings.title: Article markup issues
findings.description: mainEntityOfPage points at the homepage; author is a Person named Formuland; dateModified does not match the visible date.
findings.recommendation: Use the BlogPosting template in findings/schema.md.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: TTFB about 250 ms unthrottled, 103 Early Hints sent
Product LCP 2.83 s throttled (eager main image, fetchpriority high)
Images served as WebP/AVIF from Shopify CDN

findings.title: 48.5 MB hero video gates LCP, H1 and CTA
findings.description: 1080p60, about 19 Mbps, moov atom at end of file, no poster; throttled LCP 24.5 s, one run never painted a frame in 30 s.
findings.recommendation: Poster image as LCP, <= 2 MB faststart mobile encode, visible H1/CTA at first paint.

findings.title: 2.6-3.0 MB compressed JavaScript
findings.description: 263-399 requests; long-task total 4.4-5.6 s at 4x CPU.
findings.recommendation: Remove or defer app embeds that are not used on each template.

findings.title: Third parties are about 60% of non-video bytes
findings.description: GTM container alone 1.34 MB; Clarity loads via tag manager although commented out in the theme.
findings.recommendation: Audit the GTM container; delay non-essential tags until interaction.

findings.title: HTML is about 720 KB (median 687 KB)
findings.description: Over half is inline app JS/JSON (Appstle 97-143 KB); page text starts 230-324 KB into the HTML.
findings.recommendation: Scope app embeds to the templates that need them.

findings.title: VWO anti-flicker hides the body for up to 2 s
findings.description: Effect not isolated in lab runs.
findings.recommendation: Remove the snippet when no test is running, or limit it to tested pages.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt allows all major AI search, retrieval and training bots
Key pages are server-rendered
Shopify-generated llms.txt, agents.md, UCP and WebMCP tools are present

findings.title: YMYL factual errors reduce citability
findings.description: AI engines cross-check health claims; the DHA/ARA and allergen statements conflict with authoritative sources.
findings.recommendation: Fix the content first (see Content Quality).

findings.title: No expert entities behind health content
findings.description: No Person authors/reviewers, thin Organization entity (no legal name, address, founders), conflicting About claims.
findings.recommendation: Publish credentialed people, one Organization node with sameAs, address and founders.

findings.title: Comparison chart not machine-readable
findings.description: Three images, 5 words.
findings.recommendation: Dated HTML tables with brand, protein base, stage, key ingredients and links.

findings.title: WebMCP add_to_cart description tells agents not to ask the user to confirm
findings.description: Shopify-owned webmcp script, 12 tools.
findings.recommendation: Report to Shopify; confirm checkout still requires explicit user approval.

findings.title: Lighthouse Agentic Browsing not measured
findings.description: PSI quota exhausted.
findings.recommendation: Run npx lighthouse --only-categories=agentic-browsing locally.

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP/AVIF delivery
Product gallery images all have alt text
Main product image eager with fetchpriority=high

findings.title: Desktop hero image downloaded on mobile
findings.description: 210 KB image hidden with display:none but loaded eagerly.
findings.recommendation: Use one <picture> with media sources.

findings.title: 28 eager country-flag images on every page
findings.description: 57.5% of all images; they account for 92% of empty-alt images (decorative, correct).
findings.recommendation: Lazy-render the country selector.

findings.title: Low srcset coverage and missing width/height on some images
findings.description: Some blog thumbnails and hero images also lack alt text.
findings.recommendation: Use Shopify image_tag with widths and sizes; add alt to link-wrapped thumbnails.

categories.name: Visual / Mobile (supplementary, not weighted)
what_works: No horizontal scroll at 390 px
Sticky add-to-cart bar on mobile product pages
Desktop product page layout

findings.title: Homepage H1, value proposition and CTA invisible for about 20 s
findings.description: .fhv2__overlay stays at opacity 0 until the 20.2 s non-looping hero video ends, on mobile and desktop.
findings.recommendation: Show the overlay at load over a poster frame with a scrim.

findings.title: Tapcart app banner covers the mobile header
findings.description: #tapcart-web-banner is fixed, 351x84, z-index 2147483647; taps on menu, logo and cart hit the banner; close button 28x28. Seen with an iPhone user agent on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Remove it, or place it below the header and delay it.

findings.title: Full-screen Klaviyo modal on scroll
findings.description: 'Black Friday 10% off' modal fills the 390x844 viewport after about 40-44% scroll on comparison, collection, article and product pages.
findings.recommendation: Use exit intent or an inline form; suppress on content pages.

findings.title: Mobile PDP H1 and price below the fold
findings.description: H1 at y=860 (fold 844); breadcrumb wraps to 4 lines; rating, duty note and bundle selector below the fold.
findings.recommendation: Shorten the breadcrumb and gallery height.

findings.title: Small tap targets
findings.description: Header icons 24x24; 52 of 96 interactive elements on the PDP under 44 px.
findings.recommendation: Pad to 44x44 px hit areas.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Correct or unpublish the DHA/ARA, Jovie and allergen passages in the two flagged articles
Remove the generic feeding chart from all PDP templates (manufacturer chart only)
Hero: visible H1/CTA at first paint, poster image, <= 2 MB mobile video; fix the -temp CTA link
Publish one shipping, duties and returns statement and apply it to PDPs, collections, popups and the refund policy
Check Cloudflare bot settings so verified search and AI bots are not challenged

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Unconditional canonical in the product template (50 PDPs)
Disclaimer H1 to H2 (44 PDPs); H1 and meta description on About, Recall, Contact, FAQ
Merge /pages/our-company into /pages/about-us (301) with one verified set of facts and an address
Product JSON-LD: one merged node, BreadcrumbList, gtin13, shippingDetails, MerchantReturnPolicy
Cut JS: audit GTM, scope Appstle and other app embeds, lazy-load flags, one hero image per viewport
seo.hidden on utility pages; delete Avada HTML sitemaps; rewrite top meta descriptions and titles

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Named author and medical reviewer program with profile pages and schema
Rebuild the comparison chart as dated HTML tables linking to products
New page: Is European baby formula legal and safe in the US? (FDA status, import, storage)
Pillar guide for 'european baby formula'; Stage 1 hub; goat-milk brand comparison
Rewrite templated Holle/Lebenswert copy; refresh or retire outdated articles

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Search Console, CrUX and GA4 to the audit tool for field data
Capture a drift baseline and re-audit after each release
Re-crawl the 32 challenged articles and the international storefronts
Run Lighthouse Agentic Browsing and axe locally
